title: Amaretti Kissed Crumble
description: A sweet dessert featuring an amaretti and cookie crust topped with a crumbly kenyan kissed mixture.
instructions: In a food processor, blend Amaretti cookies until finely ground.
Add Kenyan biscuits and process until well combined.
Add softened butter and sugar; process until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Press mixture into a 9-inch springform pan.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs and a pinch of salt.
Pour egg mixture over crust and smooth the top.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until the edges are set and the center is slightly jiggly.
Let cool completely on a wire rack.
To serve, top with crumbly Kenyan kissed mixture and sliced amaretti cookies.
